description: Create a prefilled checkout link for 1-6 bookable sessions (booking_mode native) and share it with the parent. This is a shopping-list prefill, NOT a reservation: no spots are held, and the parent signs in, names their campers, signs waivers, and pays on kiddinglab.com. The response totals are in US dollars: total_usd is the camps' prices, parent_total_usd is what the parent pays before tax, including Kiddinglab's 1.5% service fee (service_fee_total_usd) — quote parent_total_usd. Sessions registered on the camp's own platform (booking_mode platform_deeplink), stale platform reports and full sessions are refused with their registration_url — send the parent there instead. Never include child names or other personal information. The link expires in 24 hours.

items.description: 1-6 sessions to prefill into the parent checkout. No PII — session ids and counts only.

children_count.description: How many children to register for this session (1-4, default 1). Do NOT include child names — the parent enters those on kiddinglab.com.

sess_id.description: Session id (sess_id from search_camps or get_camp_details).

name: create_booking_handoff
title: Create a checkout link for the parent
